items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Even when I played with Art Tatum on even when 52nd Street

ctx.x: Most of the pianos -- all of the pianos stayed at 440. (Inaudible). They had -- Steinway had people going 'round tuning the pianos all the time. Keeping them up. (Inaudible).
Even when I played with Art Tatum on even when 52nd Street, (Inaudible), I had the band with Art Tatum, every day or every other day, a guy would come over and tune that piano.
See, because Art had a way of running and his hand up (Inaudible) -- Bing! You know. He had so much power in his hand, that he'd knock the key out of tune.
